entry.title: Re: Safer sighashes and more granular SIGHASH_NOINPUT
entry.summary:
A clarification has been issued concerning the distinction between `sighash_single` and the combination `sighash_single|sighash_anyonecanpay`. Initial remarks mistakenly conflated these two, but a private communication highlighted the error. This correction aims to prevent misunderstandings among readers or developers referencing the original statements.
The importance of using precise terminology when discussing signature hash types is emphasized, as subtle differences can significantly impact transaction behavior and security considerations. Acknowledgment of the correction demonstrates a commitment to accuracy and ongoing learning within the programming community.
